chansons.style: Melodic techno, driving kick, dark arpeggiated synths, emotive male vocal, euphoric build, 128 BPM, atmospheric breakup dance track

[Intro]
(Synth fade in)

[Chorus]

[Verse 2]

[Pre-Chorus]

No use in chasing what we can't follow

[Chorus]
Severed pulse, fading out
This is what the silence is about
Severed pulse, letting go

Leave the memories behind

[Chorus]
Severed pulse, fading out
This is what the silence is about
Severed pulse, letting go
Lost inside the undertow

[Outro]
Fading out...
(Beat fades)
